title: Pocket studio, one take
description: A single continuous-feeling POV: hands find the device, tap, and a beat builds as the city moves past.
creativeGuidance: Warm practical light, macro on pads, no faces.

audio.musicPrompt: Lo-fi hip hop beat built from found sounds, 90 bpm

scenes.description: Macro: fingertip presses a glowing orange pad
scenes.prompt: extreme macro of a finger pressing an orange rubber pad on a small grey sampler, shallow depth of field, warm light

scenes.description: POV on a moving train, device on knee
scenes.prompt: first-person view on a train, small grey hardware sampler resting on knee, city lights streaking past window

scenes.description: Pull back: the beat drops, headphones on
scenes.prompt: slow pull back revealing a person putting on headphones while holding a tiny sampler, neon reflections
